name: self-improvement
description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude, (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task.
author: peterskoett
instructions:
Log learnings and errors to markdown files for continuous improvement. When an error occurs or user provides correction:

1. Log to .learnings/ERRORS.md for command failures
2. Log to .learnings/LEARNINGS.md for corrections and knowledge gaps
3. Log to .learnings/FEATURE_REQUESTS.md for missing capabilities
4. Review existing learnings before starting major tasks
5. Promote broadly applicable learnings to CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or .github/copilot-instructions.md

Use the self-improvement skill format with ID (LRN-YYYYMMDD-XXX, ERR-YYYYMMDD-XXX, or FEAT-YYYYMMDD-XXX), priority, status, area, summary, details, and metadata.
